title: Hydrate Washing System
model_title: Horizontal Vacuum Belt Filter with Counter-Current Hydrate Washing

introduction.definition: A horizontal vacuum belt filter dewaters and washes hydrate. The belt moves over vacuum boxes; hot condensate washes the cake in counter-current stages so soda content is reduced using little water.
applications: Washing of chemical and mineral filter cakes
introduction.summary: A horizontal vacuum belt filter dewaters and washes hydrate with hot condensate in counter-current stages. The belt moves over vacuum boxes; wash liquor from each later zone is used in the zone before, lowering soda in the cake with little water.

pressure.title: Counter-current washing lowers soda in the hydrate
pressure.description: Fresh hot condensate washes the cake in the last zone; its filtrate is used to wash the previous zone, and so on (counter-current). Soda in the cake falls zone by zone (red → blue) using little water. Low soda in the hydrate is essential because sodium ends up in the smelter-grade alumina product (typical spec ≲ 0.3–0.4 % Na₂O).

video_tutorials.title: Hydrate Washing System — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Hydrate Washing System.
A horizontal vacuum belt filter dewaters and washes hydrate.
The belt moves over vacuum boxes; hot condensate washes the cake in counter-current stages so soda content is reduced using little water.
Typical applications include product hydrate washing before calcination; washing of chemical and mineral filter cakes.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Hydrate Washing System — Operation

script.narration: How the Hydrate Washing System works.
Slurry is fed onto the belt.
Vacuum boxes form and dewater the cake.
Wash sprays rinse the cake.
Filtrates collect in separate receivers.
Cake discharges at the head.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.
Fresh hot condensate washes the cake in the last zone; its filtrate is used to wash the previous zone, and so on (counter-current).

video_tutorials.title: Hydrate Washing System — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Hydrate Washing System.
Check belt tracking and sprays.
Wash cloth; check seals.
Replace cloth/belt.
Watch for high soda in cake: product off-spec. Common cause: poor washing, cracked cake.
Watch for belt mistracking: edge damage. Common cause: misalignment.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
